attract.subtitle: Get a token, check in for your appointment, or get help in an emergency

language.title: Choose your language
language.hint: You can change the language at any time from the top of the screen.

home.title: How can we help you today?
home.walkInHint: No appointment? Tell us what's wrong and get a token.
home.checkInHint: Already booked? Check in for your appointment.
home.emergencyHint: Need urgent help right now? Tap here.

walkIn.title: Tell us what's wrong
walkIn.hint: Tap the microphone and speak, or type. Then answer a few short questions.

how.title: How it works
how.speak: Tell us your problem in your own words.
how.details: Enter the patient's name, age and mobile number.
how.token: Get your token and go to the department.

walkIn.pickHint: Tap the department for your problem. You'll get a token next.
walkIn.readyForToken: {{department}} is the right department. Get your token to see a doctor today.

escalated.visitHelpDesk: Please visit the help desk near the main entrance. They already have your message.

noSlots.title: No doctors are free today in {{department}}
noSlots.body: Please see the front desk. We have told them you are coming, and they will help you.
noSlots.where: The front desk is near the main entrance.
noSlots.summary: Kiosk walk-in: no doctor free today in {{department}}. Patient: {{name}}. Said: {{said}}

details.failed: We couldn't create your token. Please try again, or see the front desk.

name.title: What is the patient's name?
name.hint: Use the keyboard on the screen. Type the name of the person who will see the doctor.
name.error: Please type the patient's name (at least 2 letters).

age.title: How old is the patient?
age.hint: Use the number keys. For a baby under 1 year, enter 0.
age.error: Please enter an age from 0 to 120.

phone.title: What is your mobile number?
phone.hint: 10 digits. The front desk can reach you on this number if needed.
phone.error: Please enter a 10-digit mobile number that starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9.

slip.title: Here is your token
slip.qrHint: Show this code at the front desk if you are asked.
slip.where: Please go to {{wing}}, floor {{floor}}, and wait near Room {{room}}. Your token will be called on the screen.
slip.whereRoomOnly: Please wait near Room {{room}}. Your token will be called on the screen.
slip.printFooter: Please keep this slip until you have seen the doctor.

checkIn.title: Check in for your appointment
checkIn.scanHint: Hold the QR code from your booking, on your phone or on paper, in front of the camera.
checkIn.denied: We can't use the camera. Please type your booking ID instead.
checkIn.noCamera: No camera was found. Please type your booking ID instead.
checkIn.cameraError: The camera isn't working right now. Please type your booking ID instead.
checkIn.notOurCode: This QR code is not a MediFlow booking. Please show the QR code from your booking.
checkIn.manualHint: Your booking ID starts with MF and has 6 more letters or numbers. You will find it in your booking message.
checkIn.notFound: We couldn't find booking {{ref}}. Please check the ID and try again, or see the front desk.

reason.alreadyIn: You're already checked in. Please wait near Room {{room}}.
reason.completed: This visit is already complete. If you need to see a doctor again, please see the front desk.
reason.cancelled: This booking was cancelled. If you still need to see a doctor, please see the front desk.
reason.noShow: This appointment was marked as missed. Please see the front desk.
reason.future: Your appointment is on {{date}} at {{time}}. Please come back on that day to check in.
reason.past: This booking was for {{date}}. Please see the front desk to book a new visit.

checkIn.successBody: Please wait near Room {{room}} ({{wing}}, floor {{floor}}). Your token will be called on the screen.
checkIn.successBodyRoomOnly: Please wait near Room {{room}}. Your token will be called on the screen.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.body: For your privacy, this screen will start over soon.
idle.announce_one: The screen will start over in {{count}} second. Tap "I'm still here" to continue.
idle.announce_other: The screen will start over in {{count}} seconds. Tap "I'm still here" to continue.
